title: CPC-2023-3247-DB-COA-HCA
text:
CPC-2023-3247-DB-COA-HCA  Council District: 1 – Hernandez
  CEQA: ENV-2023-3248-CE  Last Day to Act: 07-09-26
  Plan Area: Northeast Los Angeles

  PUBLIC HEARING – Completed April 24, 2026

  PROJECT SITE:  217 North Avenue 55

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Construction, use, and maintenance of a new three-story, seven unit apartment building with one unit set
  aside for a low-income household, and one unit set aside for a very low-income household towards the rear
  of an existing historic duplex. The Project site is a 9,825.5 square foot lot that is zoned RD2-1-HPOZ and
  contains an existing historic duplex built in 1907 which is a Contributing Feature to the Highland Park –
  Garvanza Historic Preservation Overlay Zone (HPOZ). No changes to the existing historic duplex are
  proposed; all new construction will be located at the rear of the lot. The unit mix ranges from one studio,
  two units consisting of one bedroom, two units consisting of two bedrooms, and two units consisting of
  three bedrooms and the floor area of each dwelling unit will range from 437 to 1,187 square feet. The
  Project proposes seven long term bicycle parking stalls, and two short term bicycle parking stalls. The
  Project proposes to grade approximately 570 cubic yards of cut and approximately 100 cubic yards of fill.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15332, Class 32 (In-fill
  Development), an exemption from CEQA and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an
  exception to a categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies;
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1 Section 12.22 A.25 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC), a Density Bonus
  for a housing development project consisting of a new three-story, seven-unit apartment building with
  one unit set aside for a low-income household, and one unit set aside for a very low-income household
  towards the rear of an existing historic duplex and requesting the following off-on menu incentives:
  a. An Off-Menu Incentive to allow a front access passageway reduction to eight feet in lieu of the 10-
  foot requirement per LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.21 C.2(b);
  b. An On-Menu Incentive for a reduction in the rear yard setback to 12 feet in lieu of the 15-foot
  requirement per LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.22 C.10; and
  c. An On-Menu Incentive to permit a 20 percent decrease in the required east side yard setback to
  allow a five foot side yard setback in lieu of the six feet required by the RD2-1 Zone pursuant to
  LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.09.1; and
  3. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.20.3 K, a Certificate of Appropriateness for the construction
  of a new three-story, seven-unit residential building.

  Applicant:  Orlando Cetina
  Representative: Gustavo Cesareo, Citta Nuova Designs

  Staff:  Pablo Estrada, City Planning Associate
  pablo.estrada@lacity.org
  (818) 374-5033
summary: Construction of a new three-story, seven-unit apartment building with two affordable units at the rear of an existing historic duplex at 217 North Avenue 55 in the Highland Park Historic Preservation Overlay Zone.
